note: Lesson is a collocations (verb + preposition) drill plus commands; many rows sit inside 'how do you say X' drills. 21:20 bitihki looks like engine carry-over (Amal names بتفكري). [foreign language] holes at 30:11 and 31:21-33:04 (listen to me).

row.why: The throat (huwwe) hurts, so the verb is بيوجع (it), not بوجع (I); only her chat shows it and the engine may have dropped the yi-.

rulings.why: Real subject-verb slip but no voiced fix; grammar-B, low (engine could have swallowed the y).

row.medi_said: عشان الـ، ولاد دايمًا في مدرسة،
row.why: After في the place 'school' keeps el- (fi el-madrase); Amal's دايمًا فيه does not fix it, so it is let-pass.
row.english: because the kids are always in school

rulings.why: Plausible D5 let-pass; Amal voiced nothing about el-, and the engine may have dropped it - low.

row.medi_said: What happened? ... what happened with your...
row.amal_said: No. What's this question؟ كيف صرت؟ كيف صارت؟ ... How is she since...
row.right: كيف صارت = how has she been
row.why: Listening: he took كيف صارت خطيبتك as 'what happened'; Amal said No twice and gave 'How is she since'.

rulings.why: Clear listening misread with Amal's explicit No (06:46, 06:55); t moved to his first 'What happened?' at 06:33.

row.medi_said: فعل، ad adam. / شو، شو يعني قدام؟
row.why: He asked what her word قدام meant; Amal explained 'from قديم' (old) - a didn't-know on a word she said.

rulings.why: Listening: the word was Amal's, he only repeated it and asked its meaning - r1's mode is right.

row.amal_said: About. ... فيه، فيه الصبح. You need two فيهs. ... بفكر فيه الصبح because فيه you have to refer it back to أول إشي.
row.chat: awal ishi ana bafakker fiyyo el-subu7
row.why: Fronted object أول إشي needs the pointer فيه on the verb; Amal: 'You need two فيهs ... refer it back to أول إشي' (15:55).
row.english: the first thing I think about in the morning

rulings.why: Both readers saw the 15:29 pointer slip; C2 is the rule Amal named. r2's 15:23 بفكري->بفكر is the same moment as agreed A10 (she recast بفكر at 15:22/15:26), not a new row.

row.medi_said: So بـ، uh, بـ بقول is speak.
row.why: He gave بقول (say) as the verb for 'speak'; Amal said لا لا لا, just بحكي.

rulings.why: Explicit triple No with the right word; a wrong lexical item, tier 1.

row.amal_said: بس بتفكري takes what؟ ... No, we don't need عن. خلص. It's بفكر فيه. ... فيه شو بتفكري؟
row.why: 'Think about' takes في, not عن; Amal asked what بتفكري takes, then said we don't need عن, في شو بتفكري.

rulings.why: Amal's whole reaction is about the preposition (بفكر takes في), so it is grammar D2; her 'بس بتفكري' reads as if she heard the verb right, so bitihki is likely the engine carrying over the last drill.

Duplicate of D7: r1's 21:27 'So is it شو عن فيه؟' is a question about the rule inside the same moment Amal fixed at 21:29; r2's bitihki vocab-B is unproven - Amal reacts only to the preposition and names بتفكري as if he said it (likely engine).

row.amal_said: Listen to me. ... It's both, but it's listen to me. It's command. ... اسمعيني.
row.why: 'Listen to me' is a command; he offered present بسمعك (I hear you) and Amal said 'It's command' then gave اسمعيني.

rulings.why: Voiced: she repeated the English prompt, named 'command' and supplied اسمعيني; his [foreign language] attempts in between are holes, so medium.

row.why: A scary sound is بيخوّف (it frightens, doubled middle letter); بخوف = 'I fear'. Only her chat shows it - she voiced Great/ممتاز.
row.english: I heard a scary sound outside

rulings.why: Not a different word but the wrong form of خاف/خوّف (make-X, plus 'it' not 'I'), so grammar-B, not vocab-B; let-pass, low because the engine cannot show the shadda or the yi-.

row.medi_said: So the بشرحك يا... / بشرح-- شرح،
row.why: 'Explain it to me' is a command; he used present بشرحك/بشرح and Amal said 'It's command'; he then said اشرح.

rulings.why: r1's 46:08 command slip is real and separate from the 46:21 -li slip (D12); r2's row here is the D12 slip.

row.amal_said: مـم. To me. ... اشرحيني is like explain me. اشرحيني. So اشرحيلي is.
row.why: شرح takes la- for the person (explain TO me); Amal: اشرحيني is 'explain me', it is اشرحيلي.

rulings.why: Both readers wrote this slip (r2 under D11); one row.

row.medi_said: أه، بنقلقان، عشان / عشان بنقلق، Yeah. ... We worry? بنقلق؟
row.amal_said: You are worried or you worry؟ ... لا بن-- لا.
row.why: The state 'we are worried' is the participle قلقانين, not the verb بنقلق (or a mix بنقلقان); Amal asked 'worried or you worry?' and said لا; he gave قلقانين.
row.english: my fiancée and I are worried

rulings.why: The fix is verb -> participle (a form rule), so grammar B15, not vocab; t at his first try 49:42 (بنقلقان).

row.why: Listening: he gave بطلع's meaning for her بطلب; Amal said No, that's بطلع, and taught request / ask for.

rulings.why: Listening row (her word, his meaning); tier 0 like the other listening rows (D3, D4) - he then said he was 'drawing a blank', a didn't-know, not a produced wrong word.

row.medi_said: ana, ana badzakir ul kulul, uh, aglab el ... فعل

row.english: I remember most of the verbs

rulings.why: Real let-pass plural slip; the Latin stretch is messy, so low.
